bookSourceComment:
禁漫天堂 官方原版书源 (基于JM原生API完全重构)
1. 零拦截：直连官方原生 API，彻底摆脱 Cloudflare 5秒盾与拦截弹窗
2. 精确标签：分类、题材、爱心、阅读量原生提取
3. 完整评论：深度提取多级评论与回复 (replys)，层级分明
4. 纯净画质：严格锁定官方图片切片，绝无广告干扰
5. 极速翻页：全站多维筛选发现与无缝翻页

            kind: kind,

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
var $java = (this && this.java && typeof this.java.ajax === 'function') ? this.java : ((typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.ajax === 'function') ? java : null);
var targetUrl = toApiUrl(baseUrl);
var res = Getdata(targetUrl, null, $java);
var list = {};
try {
    list = JSON.parse(res);
} catch(e) {}
if ($java && typeof $java.put === 'function') {
    $java.put("book_raw_" + list.id, JSON.stringify(list));
}

var viewStr = "✦ " + Num(list.total_views);
var likeStr = "♥ " + Num(list.likes);
var tagArr = list.tags || [];
var cat = list.category ? list.category.title : "";
var allTags = [viewStr, likeStr, cat].concat(tagArr).filter(Boolean);
var kindStr = allTags.join(',').replace(/,已/g, ',').replace(/中,/g, ',');

var dateStr = (list.addtime && $java && typeof $java.timeFormat === 'function') ? $java.timeFormat(String(list.addtime * 1000)) : "";
var chapCount = (list.series && list.series.length > 0) ? ("章节数量：" + list.series.length) : "单本短篇";
var headerInfo = "📅 更新时间：" + dateStr + "      🆔 禁漫车号：JM" + list.id + "      📚 " + chapCount;
var desc = list.description ? list.description.trim() : "暂无作品叙述。";

var commentText = formatComments(list.id, 3, $java);
var fullIntro = headerInfo + "\n\n📖【作品叙述】\n" + desc + "\n\n" + commentText;

var latestName = "开始阅读";
if (list.series && list.series.length > 0) {
    latestName = "第" + list.series.length + "章 " + list.series[list.series.length - 1].name;
}

var coverUrl = imghosts[0] + "/media/albums/" + list.id + "_3x4.jpg";

var bookObj = {
    name: list.name,
    author: String(list.author || "").replace(/(&| & |\||\,|\s)/g, '/').replace(/\/+/g, '/'),
    kind: kindStr,
    latest: latestName + (dateStr ? "〔" + dateStr + "〕" : ""),
    intro: fullIntro,
    cover: coverUrl,
    url: targetUrl,
    tocUrl: targetUrl
};
bookObj;
</js>

ruleBookInfo.author: author

var $java = (this && this.java && typeof this.java.ajax === 'function') ? this.java : ((typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.ajax === 'function') ? java : null);

var list_0 = {};
if (rawStr) {
    try { list_0 = JSON.parse(rawStr); } catch(e) {}
}
if (!list_0.id) {
    try { list_0 = JSON.parse(Getdata(targetUrl, null, $java)); } catch(e) {}
}

var series = (list_0.series && list_0.series.length > 0) ? list_0.series : null;
var date = (list_0.addtime && $java && typeof $java.timeFormat === 'function') ? $java.timeFormat(String(list_0.addtime * 1000)) : "";

if (series && series.length > 0) {

    });
}

bookSourceComment:
禁漫天堂 官方原版网页直连书源 (基于18comic.vip网页端)
1. 官方网页直连：基于 https://18comic.vip 网页端 DOM 结构解析
2. 纯净过盾：集成浏览器过盾引擎，遇到 CF 自动同步 Cookie 并返回页面
3. 标签分离：原生提取分类、原作、角色、汉化组、标签与爱心数
4. 动态评论：异步调用评论组件并深度递归抓取二级回复 (replys)
5. 精准切片：严格限定 /media/photos/ 真实漫画切片，彻底剔除页面广告
6. 目录自适应：全一话短篇与连载多章智能适配

ruleBookInfo.kind:
<js>
(function() {
    var $java = (this && this.java && typeof this.java.getStringList === 'function') ? this.java : ((typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.getStringList === 'function') ? java : null);
    var tags = [];
    var addList = function(rule) {
        try {
            if (!$java) return;
            var list = $java.getStringList(rule);
            if (list) {
                for (var i = 0; i < list.size(); i++) {
                    var item = String(list.get(i)).trim();
                    if (item && item.length < 25 && tags.indexOf(item) === -1) {
                        tags.push(item);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch(e) {}
    };

    // 1. 点赞
    try {
        var like = $java ? $java.getString(".p-t-5.float-right@text || [id*='album_likes']@text") : "";
        if (like && like.trim()) tags.push("♥ " + like.trim());
    } catch(e) {}

    // 2. 分类
    addList("span[data-type=category] a@text || [data-type=category] a@text");
    // 3. 原作 / 著作
    addList("span[data-type=works] a@text || [data-type=works] a@text");
    // 4. 角色
    addList("span[data-type=actor] a@text || [data-type=actor] a@text");
    // 5. 汉化组
    addList("span[data-type=team] a@text || [data-type=team] a@text");
    // 6. 标签 Tags
    addList("#intro-block [data-type=tags] a@text || span[data-type=tags] a@text || .tag-block a@text || .tag@text");

    return tags.join(",");
})()
</js>
ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
(function() {
    var $java = (this && this.java && typeof this.java.getString === 'function') ? this.java : ((typeof java !== 'undefined' && typeof java.getString === 'function') ? java : null);
    var parts = [];

    // 1. 基本信息（车牌号与更新日期）
    var trainNo = "";
    var updateDate = "";
    var desc = "";

    try {
        if ($java) {
            trainNo = $java.getString(".train-number@text || .number@text || class.train-number@text");
            updateDate = $java.getString(".p-t-5.float-left@text || [itemprop=dateModified]@text");
            if (updateDate) updateDate = updateDate.replace(/^日期[:：]?\s*/, "").trim();
            desc = $java.getString(".intro-collapse-content@text || .col-xs-12.col-lg-7.nav-tab-content .p-t-5.p-b-5@text || .video-description@text");
            if (desc) desc = desc.replace(/^(?:叙述|敘述|簡介|简介)\s*[:：]?\s*/i, "").trim();
        }
    } catch(e) {}

    var headerLine = [];
    if (trainNo && trainNo.trim()) headerLine.push("🆔【车牌号码】 " + trainNo.trim());
    if (updateDate && updateDate.trim()) headerLine.push("📅【更新日期】 " + updateDate.trim());
    if (headerLine.length > 0) parts.push(headerLine.join("    "));

    if (desc && desc.trim()) {
        parts.push("📖【作品叙述】\n" + desc.trim());
    } else {
        parts.push("📖【作品叙述】\n暂无作品叙述。");
    }

    // 2. 评论提取（含一级与二级回复）
    var comments = [];
    var aid = baseUrl.match(/(?:album|photo)[/?](\d+)/) ? baseUrl.match(/(?:album|photo)[/?](\d+)/)[1] : "";

    // 优先尝试通过官方接口获取结构化评论
    if (aid && $java && typeof $java.ajax === 'function') {
        try {
            var forumUrl = "https://18comic.vip/ajax/album_pagination?album_id=" + aid + "&page=1";
            var resp = $java.ajax(forumUrl);
            if (resp && resp.length > 20) {
                var Jsoup = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
                var ajaxHtml = resp;
                try {
                    var jObj = JSON.parse(resp);
                    if (jObj && jObj.html) ajaxHtml = jObj.html;
                    else if (jObj && jObj.data) ajaxHtml = jObj.data;
                } catch(pe) {}
                var ajaxDoc = Jsoup.parse(ajaxHtml);
                var commentNodes = ajaxDoc.select(".comment-item, .comment_item, [id*='comment_item']");
                for (var i = 0; i < commentNodes.size() && comments.length < 15; i++) {
                    var cNode = commentNodes.get(i);
                    var u = cNode.select(".username, .user-name, strong, a[href*='user'], .name").first();
                    var c = cNode.select(".comment-content, .comment-body, .content, p").first();
                    var t = cNode.select(".comment-date, .time, small, .date").first();
                    var uStr = (u && u.text()) ? u.text().trim() : "书友";
                    var cStr = (c && c.text()) ? c.text().trim() : "";
                    var tStr = (t && t.text()) ? " [" + t.text().trim() + "]" : "";
                    if (cStr) {
                        var cBlock = tStr + "\n👤 【" + uStr + "】：\n" + cStr;
                        // 二级回复
                        var subNodes = cNode.select(".sub-comment-item, .reply-item, .comment-reply, .sub-comment");
                        for (var j = 0; j < subNodes.size() && j < 5; j++) {
                            var sNode = subNodes.get(j);
                            var su = sNode.select(".username, .user-name, strong, a[href*='user'], .name").first();
                            var sc = sNode.select(".comment-content, .comment-body, .content, p").first();
                            var st = sNode.select(".comment-date, .time, small, .date").first();
                            var suStr = (su && su.text()) ? su.text().trim() : "书友";
                            var scStr = (sc && sc.text()) ? sc.text().trim() : "";
                            var stStr = (st && st.text()) ? " [" + st.text().trim() + "]" : "";
                            if (scStr) {
                                cBlock += "\nㅤ    ↳ " + stStr + " 【" + suStr + "】：\nㅤ      " + scStr;
                            }
                        }
                        comments.push(cBlock);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch(fe) {}
    }

    // 兜底从静态 DOM 提取
    if (comments.length === 0) {
        try {
            var Jsoup2 = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;
            var rawHtml = (result ? result.toString() : (src ? src.toString() : ""));
            if (rawHtml) {
                var doc2 = Jsoup2.parse(rawHtml);
                var staticNodes = doc2.select(".comment-item, .comment_item, [id*='comment_item']");
                for (var si = 0; si < staticNodes.size() && comments.length < 15; si++) {
                    var sItem = staticNodes.get(si);
                    var su2 = sItem.select(".username, .user-name, strong, a[href*='user'], .name").first();
                    var sc2 = sItem.select(".comment-content, .comment-body, .content, p").first();
                    var st2 = sItem.select(".comment-date, .time, small, .date").first();
                    var su2Str = (su2 && su2.text()) ? su2.text().trim() : "书友";
                    var sc2Str = (sc2 && sc2.text()) ? sc2.text().trim() : "";
                    var st2Str = (st2 && st2.text()) ? " [" + st2.text().trim() + "]" : "";
                    if (sc2Str) {
                        comments.push(st2Str + "\n👤 【" + su2Str + "】：\n" + sc2Str);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch(se) {}
    }

    if (comments.length > 0) {
        parts.push("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n☕【书友评论 (" + comments.length + "条)】\n\n" + comments.join("\n\n"));
    } else {
        parts.push("━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\n☕【书友评论】\n暂无书友评论。");
    }

    return parts.join("\n\n");
})()
</js>
